ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow OCC to use the camera for QR code scanning.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: OCC connects to the desktop app on your LAN.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow OCC to use your microphone for voice dictation sent to your paired desktop for transcription.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow OCC to attach photos from your library to a terminal session on your paired desktop.
